item.title: Legal heirs of landowners not entitled to project affected persons quota; Future recruitment permitted only if eligibility criteria met: Bombay High Court
item.description: “The petitioner claiming appointment on the basis of grandfather’s land being acquired almost 45 years back and claiming to be a project affected persons was contrary to the advertisement.” The post Legal heirs of landowners not entitled to project affected persons quota; Future recruitment permitted only if eligibility criteria met: Bombay High Court appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Repo Rate Cut by RBI: Key Highlights from December 2025 Monetary Policy
item.description: RBI announced the slashing of Repo Rate from 5.50% to 5.25%. The post Repo Rate Cut by RBI: Key Highlights from December 2025 Monetary Policy appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas advised Ashoka Buildcon Limited on Macquarie’s exit from its group entities, Ashoka Concessions Limited and Jaora – Nayagaon Toll Road Company Private Limited
item.description: CAM advised Ashoka Buildcon Limited on Macquarie’s ~₹1,715 crore exit from its group entities, providing end-to-end transactional support on the divestment of stakes in Ashoka Concessions Limited and Jaora—Nayagaon Toll Road Company Private Limited. The post Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas advised Ashoka Buildcon Limited on Macquarie’s exit from its group entities, Ashoka Concessions Limited and Jaora – Nayagaon Toll Road Company Private Limited appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Madras High Court reaffirms Thengalai sect’s exclusive ritual rights at Sri Devaraja Swamy Temple in Kancheepuram
item.description: “Only the Southern Cult residents of Kancheepuram are entitled to Adhiapaka Mirasi. Northern Cult members may join only as ordinary worshippers.” The post Madras High Court reaffirms Thengalai sect’s exclusive ritual rights at Sri Devaraja Swamy Temple in Kancheepuram appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Introduction to IBA India Litigation and ADR Symposium 2025: A New Chapter in Global Legal Dialogue
item.description: The 4th IBA India Litigation and ADR Symposium organised by the IBA Asia Pacific India Working Group with the IBA Arbitration and Litigation Committees, is taking place on 5—6 December 2025 at the Taj Mahal Hotel, New Delhi , The post Introduction to IBA India Litigation and ADR Symposium 2025: A New Chapter in Global Legal Dialogue appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: RBI Issues Repeal & Amendment Directions for Co-operative Banks to Harmonize Business Authorization Guidelines – Dec 2025
item.description: On 4-12-2025, the Reserve Bank of India issued 3 Repeal Directions and one Amendment Direction to harmonize and consolidate business authorization norms for co-operative banks. The move aims to enhance operational autonomy, expand credit outreach, and promote technology-driven solutions while ensuring strong regulatory safeguards. The post RBI Issues Repeal & Amendment Directions for Co-operative Banks to Harmonize Business Authorization Guidelines – Dec 2025 appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Bombay High Court grants bail to Bhima Koregaon accused Hany Babu after prolonged incarceration of 5 years
item.description: “Prolonged incarceration without trial amounts to infringement of right of an accused enshrined under Article 21 of the Constitution of India.” The post Bombay High Court grants bail to Bhima Koregaon accused Hany Babu after prolonged incarceration of 5 years appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Parties agreeing to rate of interest cannot later challenge it on ground of public policy: SC upholds 36% interest in BPL-Morgan Securities and Credits case
item.description: BPL Ltd., having knowingly entered into the bill discounting agreement, was bound by its terms. Since it defaulted on repayment for years, the stipulated 36% compound interest could not be considered burdensome or oppressive. The post Parties agreeing to rate of interest cannot later challenge it on ground of public policy: SC upholds 36% interest in BPL-Morgan Securities and Credits case appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: From Rule of Law to Cross-Border Justice: Day 1 at the IBA India Litigation and ADR Symposium 2025
item.description: Day 1 of the 4th IBA India Litigation and ADR Symposium explored key issues shaping India’s legal landscape, including the rule of law, judicial independence, access to justice, and cross-border dispute resolution. The post From Rule of Law to Cross-Border Justice: Day 1 at the IBA India Litigation and ADR Symposium 2025 appeared first on SCC Times.
